newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mubarak sees era of violence in Israel settlement.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak sees era of violence in Israel settlement.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak said on Wednesday that Israel was leading the region into a new era of violence by building a controversial Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

"If this settlement is built this will not be the end of the whole thing. It will be the beginning of a new era of violence which we would like to avoid," he told reporters at the Ittihadiya presidential palace.

"What's happening is challenging the whole international community and is very dangerous. The situation is very serious (and) in case they don't realise the situation I fear the consequences will be terrible," he added.
He was speaking as Israeli bulldozers ripped into Jebel Abu Ghneim, or Har Homa hillside, in the disputed city for the second day despite international condemnation.
Egypt has brokered many rounds of Palestinian-Israeli peace talks and considers itself their unofficial sponsor.
